change: Persist conflict choices bound to the full preview and checkout/server context; never reuse across identities or changed variants.

desktopReal.scenario: Real conflict; choose local, reload WebView page, reopen projection and saved draft, recover choice, apply, verify bytes; then directory move and historical restore.

limitations: Choices use persistent WebView storage on this host, not the portable Store3 database; clearing that storage removes choices but keeps native draft variants.
Storage errors retain choices in memory and show a warning; current native authorization and preview validation still govern application.
MSI unsigned and uninstalled; Tauri emitted its existing bundler-type warning, automatic updater not qualified.
Direct self-review and targeted tests for this UI-only addition; no independent agent review.
